Name: ENCHANTING
Main Effect:
You have learned the art of imbuing an item with Willpower.

Whenever you take a Long Rest, you can use your Long Rest action to enchant.

Enchanting an item costs you an amount of supplies equal to 70 times the Magic Burden value of the enchantment.

At Rank 1 you learn Novice enchantments, at Rank 2 you learn Adept enchantments, and at Rank 3 you learn Master enchantments.

An item can hold one enchantment at a time.

Name: EPHEMERAL ENCHANTMENT
Main Effect:
You temporarily enchant an item you can touch for the next 1 hour.

When doing so, you choose an enchantment you know, applying its effect to the wielder of the item.

Ephemeral Enchantment costs an amount of Willpower equal to the enchantment’s Magic Burden.

This does not count toward the wielder’s Magic Burden and makes the item Attuned to the person wielding it at the moment of enchantment.

Name: WIELDER OF WONDER
Main Effect: The enchanter body is able to withstand the power of enchantments onto itself. Enchantments apply to your person. Choose one when becoming an enchanter, you can change it during a Long Rest. The amount of such enchantments you can have is equal to your rank in enchanter.

Name: LAYERED ENCHANTMENT
Main Effect:
Your work no longer crowds itself out. An item you have enchanted can hold a second enchantment beside the first.

Laying it is a Long Rest action of its own, bought at the same price, and its Magic Burden is carried on top of the first one’s.
